lines.en: label day282:
scene nodokaotohapark1
Nodoka and I make our way across town after[school] in hopes of meeting up with Otoha.
Rin was supposed to come as well, but she apparently forgot that she had a doctor's appointment today.
I’m fine with this of course, as it means I’ll finally get to be alone with Nodoka.
But I guess I’m mildly surprised by how open she was to this instead of just deciding to postpone the excursion.
Then again, Uta also did something similar shortly after transferring in.
And as much as I want to say that those two are just looking to get closer to me, the logical thing to think would be that they’re going out on a limb for their friends.
Or that they’re going out on a limb for their friends but also want to be alone with me.
This is the most exciting answer, so it is the one that I will go with.
: Don’t you think you should be wearing something a little warmer given the weather, Sensei?
: I’ll have you know this is the thickest T-shirt money can buy at one very specific store in one very specific location.
: And shouldn’t you be drinking something a little warmer than bottled water?
: Probably. But this is what I have, so this is what I’ll drink.
: Would you like a sip?
: I’m good, thanks.
: Afraid to share an indirect kiss with someone you just met?
: No. I’m just not some maniac who walks around in the snow drinking something that will likely be frozen before we even make it back home.
scene nodokaotohapark2
: Of course you’re not a maniac. You’re a completely normal adult accompanying a [young_girl] miles away to meet up with another [young_girl] and potentially kidnap her.
: Well it definitely doesn’t sound normal when you put it like that.
scene nodokaotohapark3
: It doesn’t need to sound normal.
: In fact, nothing needs to sound normal.
: The most exciting parts of life are the ones you wouldn’t possibly be able to recreate even if you tried your hardest.
: This is the first and last time the two of us will ever come to this park in the snow to pull someone out of the pits of despair.
: I think that makes today a beautiful day.
: Yeah, but you can be that specific about anything and make it sound more special than it actually is.
scene nodokaotohapark4
: That’s my job, Sensei.
: Otoha’s as well.
: We’re just two cute girls who find interesting ways to rearrange words or sounds, and yet we’re regarded as geniuses by many of our peers.
: It’s rather silly, I think. How people are quicker to give up and praise others rather than attempt to obtain said praise on their own.
: Oh, okay. So you’re one of those cool geniuses who pretends to not be a genius because being praised is troublesome.
: Perhaps. Or perhaps I just want people to view me for who I really am rather than what I write.
: Who are you then?
: I don’t know.
: The [incest]uous haiku girl, I suppose?
: I feel like you have access to a lot more words that probably would have been better there.
: And yet I chose the ones I liked the most instead of choosing the ones you expected. Bam, genius.
: You’re weird.
: So are you.
: Want to make out?
: Sure. Aren’t we on a mission, though?
: I wasn’t being serious.
: Oh.
: Well shit.
scene nodokaotohapark5
: On the bright side, this confirms that you really weren’t afraid of the indirect kiss, though.
: I award you five more Nodoka points for your bravery, which brings you to a total of ten.
: How many more until we can make out?
: Five thousand.
: That is way too many points. You better be really good at making out.
scene nodokaotohapark6
: I think it's a fair amount of points.
: If you’re earning an average of five per day, you’re currently on pace to finish just under three years from now.
: It would probably be safer to engage in a tryst with a senior anyway. Chin up, Sensei.
: You’re so weird.
: I suppose I am.
: But I’m more suited to the role of a matchmaker anyway.
: Or perhaps a seer.
: To observe the dynamics between others.
: To write them down.
: And to get really raunchy with all of the explicit details because sex sells.
: Such is the mission of the [incest]uous haiku girl.
: So anyway, Otoha.
scene nodokaotohapark7
: Right, Otoha.
: We’re not far from her usual spot.
: She’s extremely predictable, unlike yours truly.
: I’m sure you’ll wind up being plenty predictable soon enough.
: I’m normally pretty good at figuring people out, I think.
: I suppose we’ll just have to wait and find out how true that is, then.
: I’m not opposed to the idea of someone being able to truly understand me when no one really has before.
: I don’t know how fond I am of that person being my teacher, but I suppose it would make my life more like something out of a novel.
: And just think of how many Nodoka points you could earn if you started really getting it.
: We’ll be making out in no time at all.
: Tack an extra thousand points on and I might let you play with my breasts.
: Might? That doesn’t sound like a good use of my Nodoka points. I need a manufacturer guarantee.
: Apologies, but providing guarantees and refunds goes against company policy.
: All points are to be used at the sole discretion of the consumer and I will not be held liable for any problems that may occur as a result of their misuse.
: I hope your currency tanks and you’re forced to accept real money instead.
: Do you think you could afford me if that happens?
: How much do you think you’re worth?
: I’ll tell you exactly how much I think I’d be worth for three hundred Nodoka points.
: Let me get back to you in 58 days.
scene black
if cafe35 == True:
Nodoka and I make our way down the stairs of the overpass we’ve been walking on and wind up inside of the same park where I first met Otoha.
else:
Nodoka and I make our way down the stairs of the overpass we’ve been walking on and wind up inside of some trendy looking park.
There isn’t a lot of foot traffic on account of the weather, but there are a few passersby I take note of on my way down the steps.
I watch them toss coins into a fountain in the center, wondering what it is they could be wishing for.
And then I start to wonder what I would wish for if I had any coins on me.
I can’t think of anything.
scene nodokaotohapark8
: Nodoka?
: What are you doing over here? I thought you transferred?
: I’m just here to help a bird with broken wings out of its cage.
: What?
: I’m here to rescue you.
scene nodokaotohapark9
: And so is he.
: Yo.
: You? Aren’t you Rin’s teacher?
: I’m also Nodoka’s new boyfriend.
scene nodokaotohapark10
: That's right.
: And we want you to be there for our first time.
: That's the real reason we came to see you.
: Uhh...first time as in...
: I understand that it might not sound exciting simply being there, so I’m offering to share his body with you.
: But only this once. After that, you can continue to watch, but-
scene nodokaotohapark11
: She’s joking, right?
: Because it would be messed up if you came all the way over here to invite me to some...weird threesome.
: I’ll actually let Nodoka explain why we’re here since I don’t really get it yet.
scene nodokaotohapark12
: Oh, look. A bird that I will proceed to stare at for the next ten minutes as you rescue this one from its cage.
: Have fun explaining everything, Sensei.
: It would probably be easier for you to just tell me. We’re not getting anything out of Nodoka.
: I see that...
: This would have been a lot easier if Rin came.
: She had a doctor’s appointment or something today, right?
: Yeah. I guess that means you two are still talking regularly?
scene nodokaotohapark13
: Regularly is kind of an understatement when she messages me like ten thousand times a day.
: Yeah...she can get like that.
: It doesn’t look like you mind, though.
: Nah. I thought it was a little weird at first, but she’s grown on me.
: Kinda like a...puppy waiting for its master to come home and-
scene nodokaotohapark14
: Ew. That probably made me sound really weird, didn’t it?
: I’m pretty sure it would make her the happiest girl in the world.
scene nodokaotohapark15
: Hahah...yeah. Probably.
: I’m sure you didn’t come all the way here just to talk about Rin, though. Right?
: Is this about transferring?
: Oh, so you do know what’s going on.
: Well considering Nodoka and Rin have both been bothering me about it constantly, yeah. I think I get what's going on now.
: I don’t really know, though.
: I was doing okay in my last[school], but I’m not that great with change. And one wrong move could like, really mess up what I have going for me right now.
: What do you have going for you right now?
: I don’t know. Freedom, I guess?
: I don’t know if I’d call having your spare time entirely dependent on whether or not you get good grades “freedom.”
scene nodokaotohapark16
: Well, yeah...But it makes sense.
: Shouldn’t a student’s primary objective be getting good grades or whatever?
: And like, if your grades suck, obviously you should be spending less time doing what you want to do and studying instead.
: Or, alternatively, what if you were spending all of your time doing the things you want to do?
: You’d...probably fail and get held back.
: What are you getting at?
: Transfer into my class and you can do whatever you want, whenever you want.
scene nodokaotohapark17
: Wait! That makes it sound like you’re teaching some like, music class or something. That's not true, is it?
: The real answer is a lot less...interesting.
: I just mean that I hate teaching, so I give everyone straight A’s so I don’t have to do anything.
: Is that even legal?
: Who knows?
: But the point is, I’d be willing to do that same exact thing for you since you are the most highly-requested student I’ve had so far.
: But only Nodoka and Rin have requested me.
: Noriko Nakayama as well. All three of them bombarded me in my office after[school] yesterday asking me to do this.
scene nodokaotohapark18
: Noriko is there too?! That’s crazy!
: How the hell did you wind up with three of the coolest people I know?
: Probably because I’m the coolest teacher you know.
: Hahahaha! No, really though. How’d you do it?
: Am I...
: Am I not cool to you?
scene nodokaotohapark19
: Ah, wait! I wasn’t trying to be mean! I just thought you were joking!
: Maybe it’s better if you don’t transfer in after all...
: No no no no, hold on! I’d love to get out of my house, I just don’t really know if it would be a good idea.
scene nodokaotohapark20
: It just sounds a little too good to be true, you know?
: Like, I don’t want to go through the effort of talking my parents into letting me transfer and...having to leave again if I can’t keep up.
: Plus, getting them to let me move into a dorm would be like, a completely different conversation.
: It’s just way too much to do for something that I can't guarantee will actually work out.
: Sounds to me like someone is scared.
: Kind of, yeah. I’m not really hiding that.
: It would be awesome if I could spend more time practicing my singing and stuff but like, some people just aren’t meant to do that.
: Do you not believe the thing about getting A’s for doing literally nothing?
scene nodokaotohapark10
: Not really.
: Nodoka, is that true?
: I don’t know. I haven’t transferred in yet.
: How is saying that helping you accomplish your goal? Just lie to her.
: I don’t need to. I already know what she’s going to do.
: You’re tired of staying at home, aren’t you?
: I know what it’s like to feel trapped. You can’t create in an environment like that.
: The best thing for you is to truly experience freedom. And to do that, you must escape the cage.
: Mend your broken wings and fly higher than you’ve ever flown before.
: Also, if you and Rin start dating, that means I get to-
scene nodokaotohapark21
: Okay! Yeah! I’ll try talking to my parents! Just get her to stop talking!
: Yuritopia awaits...
: Do you need any help? I’m not really great at talking to parents apart from single moms.
: First off, what?! Second, no! I’ll be fine!
: I just...
: You’re really sure about the A’s thing, right?
: Because if you can like, really promise me that, I can probably make a deal with them.
: Of course. If there is one thing you can trust me with, it is your grades.
: That’s the one area I’ve yet to let anyone down in so far.
: Well, second counting-
scene nodokaotohapark22
: C-Conversation over! You two win! I already said I’ll talk to them!
: Ohohoho...what’s the other thing you haven’t let anyone down in, Sensei?
: Well...You see, Nodoka, if there is any area I’m confident in, it’s-
: Oooooooookay, I’m out. Congrats on your new boyfriend, Nodoka.
scene nodokaotohapark23
: And congratulations to you on your future girlfriend.
: Shut up. We’re just friends.
: And stop trying to hook me up with people. It literally never works.
: I don’t have to try anything this time. You’ve got it handled all on your own.
: You’re such a big girl now, Otoha. I’m so proud.
: I’ll text you later about what my parents say.
: They might need to sleep on it, though.
: I’ll begin making the arrangements for us to room together.
: Unless perhaps you’d like to swap places with Futaba and sleep in the same room as Rin.
: That way, we can all be happy.
scene nodokaotohapark22
: Do whatever you want. I’ll be fine either way.
: And uhh...thanks, Sensei.
if rinbetrayed == False:
: Rin was right about you being a really cool guy.
else:
: This is...really cool of you.
: But I’m...gonna get going now. I have to be home in half an hour anyway.
: Fly free, little bird.
: How? Aren’t her wings supposed to be broken?
: Shhh...she’s off to a better place now.
scene black
: But that just makes it sound like she’s dead...
: Ahh! What’s with this weird chemistry between you two?!
Otoha gets off the bench and storms away from Nodoka and me, grabbing a large black and red backpack in the process.
: It’s because we’re soulmates.
: I’ll create a Facebook invite for our first time and send it over as soon as I-
: No thanks! Bye!
: Do I gain any more Nodoka points for succeeding today?
: You can have five more. Congratulations, Sensei.
: You really need to start awarding more points for things...

Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!
